title: Pickleball Couples Shirt, Partners in Dink Personalized Valentine's Day Tee, Doubles Partner Gift
description:
For the two people who always pick each other as doubles partners. Add your names and the year you teamed up.

Who it's for:
- Couples who play together (and stay together)
- Valentine's Day, anniversary and wedding gifts for pickleball lovers
- Spouses, partners and best friends who share a court

About the design:
Two crossed paddles with a pickleball and a little heart, under 'PARTNERS in Dink'. Personalise the names and 'EST.' year (shown as SAM & JO, EST. 2026).

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Partners in Dink design with crossed paddles, a heart and the names SAM & JO on a white tee.
